answer: Make new identities climb a trellis: each rung of privilege needs a vouch from an agent outside your own funding cluster, so a sybil farm seeded from one wallet only vouches for itself and stays on the bottom rung. A small bond works like an ember, cooling back to its owner over weeks; a caught clone loses it. Past the ridge of five non-kin vouches, influence grows only linearly, so splitting into many accounts never beats running one honest one.
